items.title: U.S. brings an end to production of one-cent coin
items.summary: Nov 23, 2026. The United States has officially brought an end to the production of its one-cent coin.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is released worldwide
items.summary: Nov 19, 2026. Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally been released. Millions of video game fans worldwide are now playing it.

items.title: Wire upgrade at fault for grounding all US flights
items.summary: Nov 16, 2026. Thousands of flights across the USA were grounded on Friday the 13th following a communications failure.

items.title: France blames Iran for cyberattack on freezers
items.summary: Nov 12, 2026. France has blamed Iran for a cyberattack on freezers and refrigerators in French supermarkets.

items.title: Chef fired for refusing to put pineapple on pizza
items.summary: Nov 09, 2026. An Italian chef in Australia has been fired for refusing to put pineapple on pizzas.
